                                CHAPTER SIXTEEN / MIXED STRATEGY: HAND REVIEW / DANIEL NEGREANU




If you bet the flop, you have to bet some turns. To decide
when, you use a variety of factors, such as picking up a
draw, as you see in this hand. Sometimes you should bet
both flop and turn, and sometimes you can check-call
and check the turn to reassess your situation. In this
particular hand, the turn       changed little, so
check-calling actually made a lot of sense for Esfandiari.
The lesson here is that you have to take different lines
with the same hand.
